decision: Merge skills-export into a branch off main, and delete the two retired skills in a commit before that merge
why: A removal commit keeps the original commit ids. Rewriting with filter-repo would replace every id.

decision: Fetched the private dotfiles branch after the unauthenticated fetch returned not found
why: The credential already on this repo could not see dotfiles. Access for that repo was granted, and the fetch then worked.

decision: Left the scraping notes that mention env var names
why: gitleaks found no secrets. The hits in prose are placeholders and os.environ lookups.

decision: Keep disable-model-invocation on the real skill files, and run skills-ref against a copy with that one line removed
why: Claude Code reads the top-level field. The spec validator rejects it. Any other extra field still fails.
Patryk limited CI to that runner. The check rejects macOS, Windows, and a matrix.

decision: Ban bash 4 and GNU-only flags in shell and skill scripts, and run shellcheck in the Ubuntu job
why: The scripts have to run on macOS bash 3.2 and BSD tools. The runner stays Ubuntu.

decision: Give handlers/detail.py a fenced block in the modular Crawlee template
why: main.py imports register_detail_handlers, and the apply script only writes fenced files.
result: second apply run printed unchanged and wrote handlers/detail.py
